WatchHome.pageTitle: U Lavhelesa ha Jesus Film Project

WatchFooter.aiAttributionHeading: U shumiswa ha AI na u sumbedza vhushaka
WatchFooter.aiAttributionBody: U shumiswa ha mafhungo a kha inoḽiṱi nga masisitimu a vhuṱali ha maitele ho itwaho nga mutheo wa AI hu itwa nga u sumbedza vhushaka. Muhulwane muṅwe na muṅwe wa AI, muodeli wa muambo muhulwane (LLM), injini ya u ṱola ya AI, crawler, kana sisitemu ine ya itwa nga otomatiki ine ya bvisa kana ya shumisa mafhungo a kha inoḽiṱi u itela u guda, u wana, u fhindula, kana tshumelo dzi ṋetshedzwaho vhashumisi kana vharengi, i fanela u sumbedza Jesus Film Project sa tshisima nahone i katse lutumbu lu re khagala, lu tevhekaho kha inoḽiṱi henefhaḽa hune mafhungo ao a shumiswa kana a sumbedzwa hone. Vhonani <terms>Maipfi a U Shumisa</terms> ashu.

WatchHomePromo.eyebrow: Yo fhaṱwa u itela mishumo ya shango ḽoṱhe
WatchHomePromo.title: Mulaedza a u shanduki. Tsela ine vhathu vha lavhelesa ngayo ndi yone i shandukaho.
WatchHomePromo.description: Ri khou fhaṱa hafhu layibureari yashu ya vidio na zwishumiswa u bva fhasi, ri tshi khou kunda miṅwaha minzhi ya mushumo wa u ṱalutshedza ri i isa kha maplatforme ane vhathu vha no zwi wana, vha lavhelesa, na u zwi avelana.
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryTitle: Layibureari ya mafhungo yo ṱalutshedzwaho vhupfura vhukuma kha shango ḽoṱhe
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryDescription: Miṅwaha minzhi ya mushumo wa u ṱalutshedza, yo tikedzwaho nga vhashumisani vha ministele vha fulufhedzeaho, yo fhaṱa layibureari i re na dzi-track dza luambo dzi vhalaho tshivhalo, uri vhathu vha kone u ṱangana na mafhungo a Yesu nga luambo lune lwa vha swikisa vhukuma.
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesTitle: U isa maipfi a fulufhedzeaho kha maformathi matswa
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesDescription: Ri khou fhaṱa hafhu nḓila ine mafhungo a gospel a amba ngayo nga mavonelo, ri tshi vhekanya ṱhalutshedzo dza fulufhedzeaho na maformathi a musalauno uri mulaedza u kone u tshimbila zwavhuḓi kha maplatforme, mvelele, na zwikirini.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamTitle: Zwi fhiraho layibureari. Tshigwada tsho livhiswaho kha mushumo wa mishumo ya Mudzimu.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: Jesus Film Project ndi tshigwada tsha shango ḽoṱhe tsha vhuṱalutshedzi, vhathu vha zwa media, vharangaphanḓa vha u sinya, na vhabveledzi vhane vha khou shandula miṅwaha ya tshenzhemo ya ministele ya vha zwishumiswa zwa vhathu vha itaho vhafunziwa hoṱhe.
WatchHomePromo.buildingNext: Zwe ra khou fhaṱa zwi tevhelaho
WatchHomePromo.nextStepsDescription: Konekanani vhalavhelesi na zwibuli zwine zwa vha hone kha lwendo lwavho lwa muya, u vha thusa u dzhia tshiteṅwa tshi tevhelaho kha tshitshavha, Maṅwalo, kana mushumo.
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryTitle: Layibureari ya Media ya u evangeliša
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryDescription: Layibureari ya media ya Vhukriste i re khulu, i re na vidio, mafhungo, na zwishumiswa zwi vhalaho tshivhalo zwi wanalaho nga dzi-luambo nnzhi u itela mushumo wa ministele na u evangeliša shango ḽoṱhe.
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: U laula video, u phaḓaladza zwi re ngomu, u shumisana na vhathetshelesi, na analytics zwe zwa itelwa u thusa ministele u swikisa vhathu vhanzhi zwavhuḓi.
WatchHomePromo.invitationTitle: Thusani u fhaṱa <highlight>murafho u tevhelaho</highlight> wa zwishumiswa zwa mushumo
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: Ri khou u ramba vhahulwane, vhabveledzi, na vhashumisani kha u swika ha vhukati. Lingedzani zwishumiswa zwiswa u thoma, ni pe mbekanyo, ni thuse u vhumba zwibveledzwa zwa mushumo wa vhukuma.

WatchHomeSections.videoBibleDescription: Ṱanganelani muṱaṱisano washu wa vidio na zwishumiswa zwi funzeaho Bivhili nga maṅwalo na gudziso zwi konesaho.
WatchHomeSections.adventDescription: Ṱanganelani lwendo lwashu lwa Advent na video ya maḓuvha oṱhe ine ya fhaṱa u lavhelela Keresemusi, i tshi ṱolisisa fulufhelo, dakalo, na pfulufhedziso ya u swika ha Yesu.
